changed: e-agent-harness tidy formats and lints the whole change once (ruff check --fix, ruff format; the UI scoped formatter when ui/ changed) and exits 1 with what it cannot fix; the PostToolUse format hook and the hook script's format mode are removed (four hooks remain); eng-session runs tidy before the commit. Owner decision 2026-10-13.

rulings.ruling: tidy runs ruff through the harness interpreter (python -m ruff) with --force-exclude, so configured exclusions such as docs/ and research/ hold for named files
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a checkout whose harness environment lacks ruff reports nothing to fix

rulings.ruling: A ui/ change runs the UI formatter on its migrated scope, not on the changed files, so modules not yet migrated to Prettier are not reformatted
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a changed ui file outside the migrated scope stays unformatted, which format:check does not require
